text:
Starting cash: seeds the strategy's cash ledger for backtests and sizing; does not by itself change signal logic.

Starting crypto quantity: optional pre-existing base asset; when set, the engine may seed a long once inside the active window so performance metrics reflect holdings the user already carried.

Backtest window start/end: bounds when signals and orders may fire; narrowing the window is useful for event studies but will truncate sample size.

Exit full on last historical bar: optional flatten for clean backtest endings — disable for forward-looking live tuning so open risk carries realistically.
